triplets.head: De Simone formulation (8-strain)
triplets.tail: Visbiome (US), Vivomixx (EU); no longer the product sold under VSL#3 name

triplets.head: De Simone formulation for pouchitis maintenance
triplets.tail: RCT n=40: 85% remission in probiotic vs 6% placebo at 9 months

triplets.head: De Simone formulation for pouchitis prophylaxis
triplets.tail: RCT n=40: pouchitis onset 10% probiotic vs 40% placebo at 12 months

triplets.head: De Simone formulation for pouchitis
triplets.tail: RCT n=36: 100% remission maintained in probiotic vs 67% relapse in placebo

triplets.head: De Simone formulation for UC
triplets.tail: RCT n=144: 42.9% remission probiotic vs 15.7% placebo

triplets.head: De Simone formulation
triplets.tail: Only probiotic recommended for pouchitis (AGA 2020 and AGA 2024 pouchitis guideline)

triplets.head: Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis BB-12
triplets.tail: Over 130 human clinical publications; most documented Bifidobacterium strain

triplets.head: BB-12 for diarrhea prevention
triplets.tail: RCT in hospital setting (n=55): diarrhea 7% probiotic vs 31% control; rotavirus shedding 10% vs 39%

triplets.head: BB-12 for immune function
triplets.tail: RCT (n=106): significantly higher influenza-specific antibody response vs placebo in vaccination model

triplets.head: BB-12 for respiratory infections
triplets.tail: RCTs showing fewer RTIs in infants; cold duration −2 days and severity −34% in college students (with LGG)

triplets.head: BB-12
triplets.tail: Recommended for infantile colic in breastfed infants (≥10^8 CFU/day for 21–28 days)

triplets.head: L. acidophilus CL1285 + L. casei LBC80R
triplets.tail: C. difficile prevention (marketed as Bio-K+)

triplets.head: ESPGHAN 2023 guideline

triplets.head: Ivanov et al. 2009
triplets.tail: Cell

triplets.head: Ivanov et al. 2009
triplets.tail: Segmented filamentous bacteria (SFB) are sufficient to induce intestinal Th17 cells in mice

triplets.head: Ivanov et al. 2009
triplets.tail: Taconic B6 mice had abundant Th17 cells and harbored SFB; Jackson B6 mice lacked both

triplets.head: Ivanov et al. 2009
triplets.tail: Germ-free mice mono-colonized with SFB developed robust Th17 cell accumulation in lamina propria within 10 days

triplets.head: Ivanov et al. 2009
triplets.tail: Colonization with Bacteroides or defined Clostridium mix did not induce Th17 cells; SFB-specific

triplets.head: SFB Th17 induction mechanism
triplets.tail: SFB adhere tightly to epithelial cells in terminal ileum

triplets.head: SFB Th17 induction mechanism
triplets.tail: Epithelial cells upregulate Serum Amyloid A (SAA), particularly Saa1

triplets.head: SFB Th17 induction mechanism
triplets.tail: SAA acts on lamina propria dendritic cells to produce IL-6 and IL-23

triplets.head: SFB Th17 induction mechanism
triplets.tail: Naïve CD4+ T cells differentiate into RORγt+ Th17 cells producing IL-17 and IL-22

triplets.head: SFB-induced Th17 cells
triplets.tail: Conferred resistance to intestinal pathogen Citrobacter rodentium by enhancing mucosal immunity

triplets.head: SFB-induced Th17 cells
triplets.tail: Triggered spontaneous autoimmune arthritis in K/BxN mice; GF K/BxN mice remained disease-free until SFB introduced

triplets.head: Goto et al. 2014
triplets.tail: Immunity

triplets.head: Goto et al. 2014
triplets.tail: MHCII-dependent antigen presentation of SFB antigens by intestinal DCs is crucial for Th17 induction

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2011
triplets.tail: Science

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2011
triplets.tail: Clostridium clusters IV and XIVa specifically induce colonic Foxp3+ regulatory T cells in mice

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2011
triplets.tail: GF mice colonized with 46 strains of Clostridium (clusters IV, XIVa) showed robust Treg accumulation in colonic lamina propria

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2011
triplets.tail: Lactobacillus, SFB, or B. fragilis did not significantly increase colonic Tregs; Clostridium-specific effect

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2011
triplets.tail: IL-10+ CTLA4-high Foxp3+ Helios-negative (peripherally induced Tregs)

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2011
triplets.tail: Clostridium colonization induced IECs to produce active TGF-β; IEC supernatant drove Foxp3 differentiation blocked by anti-TGF-β

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2011
triplets.tail: Treg induction occurred normally in MyD88-/-, Rip2-/-, and Card9-/- knockout mice

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2011
triplets.tail: Neonatal inoculation with Clostridium → resistance to DSS-induced and oxazolone-induced colitis; reduced systemic IgE

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Nature

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2013
triplets.tail: 17 human-derived Clostridia strains (clusters IV, XIVa, XVIII) sufficient to induce Foxp3+ Tregs in GF mice via SCFA production

triplets.head: Atarashi et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Bridged mouse findings to human-derived bacteria; identified SCFA as mechanistic link

triplets.head: Furusawa et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Nature

triplets.head: Furusawa et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Butyrate induces colonic Treg differentiation via histone H3 acetylation at Foxp3 promoter and CNS regions

triplets.head: Furusawa et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Among acetate, propionate, and butyrate tested, butyrate was most potent inducer of Treg differentiation

triplets.head: Furusawa et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Butyrate acts as HDAC inhibitor → opens chromatin at Foxp3 locus → enhanced Foxp3 transcription → stable Treg identity

triplets.head: Furusawa et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Butyrate treatment ameliorated colitis in adoptive transfer model (CD4+ CD45RBhi T cells into Rag1-/- mice)

triplets.head: Smith et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Science

triplets.head: Smith et al. 2013
triplets.tail: SCFAs regulate colonic Treg homeostasis via GPR43 (Ffar2) receptor in a Treg-intrinsic manner

triplets.head: Smith et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Oral SCFA supplementation (150 mM) to GF mice for 3 weeks increased colonic Treg frequency and number; no effect in spleen/MLN/thymus

triplets.head: Smith et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Propionate enhanced Foxp3 and IL-10 expression; boosted Treg suppressive capacity and proliferation

triplets.head: Smith et al. 2013
triplets.tail: In Ffar2-/- mice, propionate completely failed to increase cTregs; protection was absent

triplets.head: Smith et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Propionate via GPR43 reduced HDAC6 and HDAC9 expression and enhanced histone acetylation in cTregs

triplets.head: Smith et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Propionate protected against T cell transfer colitis only when Tregs were present and expressed GPR43

triplets.head: Smith et al. 2013
triplets.tail: Complementary: both show HDAC inhibition, but Smith identifies GPR43 receptor-mediated pathway; propionate most potent via GPR43 while butyrate most potent via direct HDAC inhibition

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA
triplets.tail: 3–5 grams per day; ~80% of all plasma cells located in intestinal mucosa

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA
triplets.tail: Germ-free mice have severely reduced IgA in intestinal secretions and sera; restored upon conventionalization

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA
triplets.tail: 20–50% of commensal bacteria are coated with IgA

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA T-dependent pathway
triplets.tail: Germinal centers in Peyer's patches and mesenteric lymph nodes

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA T-dependent pathway
triplets.tail: CD40L on T follicular helper (Tfh) cells → CD40 on B cells; IL-21 and TGF-β from Tfh cells

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA T-dependent pathway
triplets.tail: High-affinity IgA via somatic hypermutation

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA T-dependent pathway
triplets.tail: Targets discrete highly penetrant commensals; controls specific pathobionts

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA T-independent pathway
triplets.tail: Outside germinal centers (lamina propria, isolated lymphoid follicles)

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA T-independent pathway
triplets.tail: APRIL and BAFF from DCs/macrophages/epithelial cells → TACI receptor on B cells

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA T-independent pathway
triplets.tail: Low-affinity polyreactive IgA; no somatic hypermutation

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA T-independent pathway
triplets.tail: Primarily B1b cells (~40% of intestinal IgA-producing plasma cells)

triplets.head: Intestinal IgA T-independent pathway
triplets.tail: Broadly targets many commensals with polyreactive binding; provides initial firewall

triplets.head: SCFAs and IgA production
triplets.tail: Acetate conditions DCs to produce retinoic acid via GPR43 → drives IgA class switch recombination in B cells

triplets.head: SCFAs and IgA production
triplets.tail: Butyrate via GPR109a on DCs produces retinoic acid but drives Treg induction rather than IgA production

triplets.head: Tregs and Th17 cells
triplets.tail: Both convert to T follicular helper (Tfh) cells in Peyer's patches to drive TD IgA production

triplets.head: Th17 to Tfh conversion
triplets.tail: Commensal-derived TLR2 ligands activate T cell-intrinsic MyD88 signaling in Peyer's patches

triplets.head: Hapfelmeier et al. 2010
triplets.tail: Science

triplets.head: Hapfelmeier et al. 2010
triplets.tail: Single transient bacterial exposure induced IgA but not sustained; continuous microbial stimulation required; multiple colonizations needed for mature high-affinity IgA repertoire

triplets.head: Palm et al. 2014
triplets.tail: Cell

triplets.head: Palm et al. 2014
triplets.tail: IgA-seq: FACS separation of IgA-coated from IgA-uncoated bacteria followed by sequencing

triplets.head: Palm et al. 2014
triplets.tail: Bacteria heavily coated with IgA were enriched for colitogenic pathobionts; transferring high-IgA-coated bacteria from IBD patients to GF mice exacerbated colitis

triplets.head: IgA-deficient mice
triplets.tail: Develop dysbiosis — altered composition and diversity of commensal bacteria; confirms IgA actively shapes community structure

triplets.head: Mazmanian et al. 2005/2008
triplets.tail: B. fragilis polysaccharide A (PSA) corrects Th1/Th2 imbalance in GF mice and induces IL-10-producing Foxp3+ Tregs; protects against colitis

triplets.head: SFB and Th17 cells
triplets.tail: Same commensal-induced immune pathway that protects gut against pathogens can drive autoimmune disease at distant sites in genetically susceptible hosts

triplets.head: Clostridiales-Treg-SCFA axis
triplets.tail: Dietary fiber → fermented by Clostridiales → SCFAs (butyrate, propionate) → HDAC inhibition + GPR43 signaling → Foxp3 acetylation → stable colonic Treg induction → suppress inflammation

triplets.head: Microbiome immune education
triplets.tail: Remove microbiota (GF conditions) and colonic Tregs, mucosal Th17 cells, and IgA production are all simultaneously lost; continuous microbial input required
